name: digital-workplace-cloud-infrastructure-suite
known_facts: Multi-cloud adds 30-40% operational overhead per provider
Terraform state should be remote with state locking and access auditing
Kubernetes namespaces are not a security boundary
Container images should be <500MB and run as non-root
Zero Trust means no inbound rules from internet, mTLS for inter-service comms

input.compliance_boundary: SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS Level 1
input.aws_workloads: All employee-facing apps (HR, Payroll, Expense, Analytics, Collaboration tools)
input.aws_rationale: Existing investment, strong EKS and RDS support, broadest compliance certifications
input.aws_exit: Containerized workloads (portable to Azure AKS or GCP GKE within 3 months)
input.azure_workloads: M365 integration point, Azure AD as identity source
input.azure_rationale: M365 ecosystem integration, Azure AD as identity provider for zero-trust
input.azure_exit: M365 dependency limits exit options, identity can be migrated to Okta (6-month project)
input.gcp_rationale: No business case for third cloud provider at this time
input.storage_state: Terraform Cloud (separate workspace per data classification)
input.identity_tool: Terraform (Azure AD provider + AWS IAM provider)
input.monitoring_state: Terraform Cloud (shared workspace with management team)
input.cluster_1_ns: hr, finance, payroll, analytics, collaboration, platform
input.cluster_1_addons: Istio (service mesh), cert-manager, Vault CSI Provider, Karpenter
input.cluster_2_nodes: 2 node groups: general (m6i.large), spot instances for non-production
input.cluster_2_addons: Istio (service mesh), cert-manager, Vault CSI Provider, Karpenter
input.cluster_3_nodes: 1 node group: general (m6i.large), minimum 2 nodes for DR readiness
input.cluster_3_addons: Istio (service mesh), cert-manager, Vault CSI Provider
input.network_isolation: Kubernetes NetworkPolicies (deny-all default) + Calico for global policies
input.network_a: Can reach: HR namespace only. Ingress from: platform ingress gateway.
input.network_b: Can reach: Finance namespace only. Ingress from: platform ingress gateway.
input.network_c: Can reach: Platform namespace only. Ingress from: cluster ingress.
input.compute_isolation: ResourceQuotas + LimitRanges per namespace, PriorityClasses for critical workloads
input.compute_a: CPU limit: 16 cores, Memory: 64Gi, Priority: business-critical
input.compute_b: CPU limit: 24 cores, Memory: 96Gi, Priority: business-critical
input.compute_c: CPU limit: 32 cores, Memory: 128Gi, Priority: platform
input.storage_isolation: RDS instances per business unit (no shared databases), S3 buckets with bucket policies
input.storage_a: RDS PostgreSQL hr-db, S3 hr-data bucket (SSE-KMS, CMK per BU)
input.storage_b: RDS PostgreSQL finance-db, S3 finance-data bucket (SSE-KMS, CMK per BU)
input.storage_c: S3 platform-logs (SSE-S3), S3 platform-artifacts (SSE-KMS, shared CMK)
input.identity_isolation: Azure AD groups mapped to Kubernetes RBAC via EKS access entries
input.identity_a: Azure AD group hr-team -> k8s hr-{admin,edit,view} roles
input.identity_b: Azure AD group finance-team -> k8s finance-{admin,edit,view} roles
input.identity_c: Azure AD group platform-team -> k8s platform-admin + cluster-view roles
input.obs_isolation: Datadog dashboards per business unit, metrics tagged by namespace and BU
input.obs_a: Datadog HR dashboard, hr-* metrics tags, pagerduty hr-oncall
input.obs_b: Datadog Finance dashboard, finance-* metrics tags, pagerduty finance-oncall
input.obs_c: Datadog Platform dashboard, platform-* metrics tags, pagerduty platform-oncall
input.public_trust: None (no direct internet ingress for employee apps)
input.public_inspection: AWS WAF on ALB, Shield Advanced for DDoS protection
input.internal_inbound: Allow from ingress gateway on 443, deny all other inbound
input.internal_outbound: Allow to authorized external APIs (via Egress Gateway)
input.internal_inspection: Istio telemetry + Datadog APM trace sampling
input.data_inbound: Allow from namespace-specific service accounts only
input.data_outbound: Deny all (data services should not initiate outbound connections)
input.data_inspection: RDS audit logs to CloudWatch + Datadog, S3 access logs to security analytics
input.mgmt_inbound: Allow from corporate VPN (Azure AD conditional access) + bastion hosts
input.mgmt_outbound: Allow to cluster API server, deny all else
input.mgmt_inspection: CloudTrail + Datadog audit logs + GuardDuty for EKS
